local_evidence.carry_report: Imported StoneBlock carry report enumerates five blocks: ender_air, glossed_magma, glow_air, lightning_air, signal_air; it maps the first/four air blocks to minecraft:stone and glossed_magma to minecraft:wheat.
local_evidence.localized_features: Imported en_us localization lists the Holding enchantment as increasing storage capacity of certain items, Shimmer as a disabled enchantment, and 18 CoFH status-effect names. It includes command feedback strings for heal, ignite, repair, invisibility, invulnerability, recharge, and zap. Localization identifies names but does not specify full mechanics.
local_evidence.stoneblock_config: The local common config disables Fishing Exhaustion and Sapling Growth Reduction.
local_evidence.inventory: StoneBlock inventory records version 9.2.3, logic tier, 5 blockstates, zero item models, 1 recipe and 1 loot table.

existing_prototype_assessment.location: Imported pack only; not in the repository.
existing_prototype_assessment.finding: Its `_air` block hook schedules replacement with minecraft:air after a configurable default delay and plays teleport/lightning sounds for entities inside; those semantics are not established by the carry report or public docs consulted, so they cannot be treated as a faithful implementation or evidence. Its `/cofh status` command only reports its own counter and is not a CoFH Core gameplay command.

api_gap: API 0.3 has no server mutation to heal an entity/player, apply a status effect, or set entity invulnerability/invisibility/charge.
API 0.3 provides no entity-target query/selector or inventory/equipment repair command contract.
The SDK has no mod-owned enchantment registration or general item capacity callback; a Holding implementation would also need connected Thermal container behavior.
reference_docs: https://teamcofh.com/docs/1.15/cofh-core/commands/ (cross-version reference; no 1.18 CoFH Core command page was found)
https://teamcofh.com/docs/1.15/cofh-core/status-effects/ (cross-version reference; not proof of identical 1.18 behavior)
